attack_path.action: In the Balancer protocol, users can earn rewards by depositing their LP tokens in the AuraPool.
The calculated TVL of a vault is the basis to determine how much value a user gets when withdrawing shares from the vault.
if a user redeems 10% of all vault shares he will get 10% of the calculated TVL.
Since the calculated TVL is lower than the actual TVL, any user who withdraws from the vault will receive less value for his shares than he should be receiving.

The calculated TVL is also used to determine how many shares a user gets when depositing to the vault by multiplying the value the user wants to supply with the outstanding shares and dividing it by the calculated TVL.
Since the calculated TVL is lower than the actual TVL, users depositing to the vault will get more share minted to them than they should be getting.
